name: protect-env
description: Keeps .env files out of the conversation: the agent may not read them.

files.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Claude Code hands the tool call as JSON on the standard input.
if grep -Eq '\.env($|[^A-Za-z])'; then
  echo 'Blocked by the protect-env hook: .env files hold secrets, and stay out of the conversation. Ask the user for the values you need.' >&2
  exit 2
fi
